from pyscf import lib

def which_recipe(atom, spin, basis="sto-3g", grid=1):
    from pyscf import dft
    mol = B.build_molecule(atom, basis=basis, spin=spin)
    scfx = (dft.UKS if spin else dft.RKS)
    for i, rec in enumerate(B.SCF_RECIPES):
        t0 = time.time()
        mf = scfx(mol); mf.xc="PBE"; mf.grids.level=grid
        mf.conv_tol=1e-9; mf.conv_tol_grad=1e-6
        mf.max_cycle = max(mf.max_cycle, int(rec.get("max_cycle", mf.max_cycle)))
        for k,v in rec.items():
            if k!="max_cycle": setattr(mf,k,v)
        mf.kernel()
        dt = time.time()-t0
        print(f"   recipe#{i} {rec}: conv={mf.converged} t={dt:.0f}s", flush=True)
        if mf.converged:
            return i, dt
    return None, None

targets = ["decacene"]
for s in B.load_validation_study_systems("fragment_alpha"):
    if s.label in targets:
        spin = B._spin_from_atom_spec(s.atom_spec)
        t0=time.time()
        r, dt = which_recipe(s.atom_spec, spin)
        print(f"{s.label}: recipe={r} total_wall={time.time()-t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
